# PredictPro.guru — Full Quantitative Football Analytics & Agent Reference (llms-full.txt)

> PredictPro.guru (`https://predictpro.guru`) is an enterprise AI football prediction and quantitative sports analytics platform delivering 84%–87% verified accuracy on high-confidence Banker Picks across 40+ global competitions using Bivariate Poisson scoreline distributions, Expected Goals (xG) differentials, Dixon-Coles low-scoring adjustments, ELO club ratings, and real-time market steam.

## 2. Quantitative Mathematical Architecture

1. **Bivariate Poisson Distribution**: Computes exact scoreline probabilities $P(X = x, Y = y)$ from attacking and defensive strength vectors $\lambda_{\text{Home}}$ and $\lambda_{\text{Away}}$ adjusted for league-specific home advantage and Dixon-Coles low-score correlation $\rho$.
2. **Expected Goals (xG & xGA)**: Rolling 10-match non-penalty xG and shot-quality metrics weighted by opponent ELO rating.
3. **Positive Expected Value (+EV) Identification**: Compares true model probability $P_{\text{AI}}$ against de-vigged bookmaker implied probability $P_{\text{Implied}}$ to surface edges where $\text{EV} = (P_{\text{AI}} \times \text{Odds}) - 1 > 3.5\%$.
4. **Mega & Midweek Jackpot Permutation Engine**: Synchronizes live upcoming fixtures across SportPesa (17 games), Betika (15 games), Mozzart (20 games), and SportyBet (12 games), classifying high-probability Banker locks and $2^N$ Double Chance (`1X`, `X2`, `12`) hedges.
